name: personal-health-advisor-expert
description: A local-first personal health record advisor: daily records, field-by-field lab confirmation, a live local health workbench inside WorkBuddy, and visit-summary drafts, without diagnosing or prescribing.

author.name: 北京海纳福星文化传媒有限公司

displayDescription.zh: 整理本机加密健康档案与日常记录，生成个人健康管理工作台和就医摘要草稿；不诊断、不处方。
displayDescription.en: Keeps an encrypted health record on your own computer, builds a local health workbench and visit-summary drafts, and never diagnoses or prescribes.

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 先用虚构示例展示健康工作台，再告诉我如何创建自己的档案。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Show me the fictional demo workbench, then explain how to set up my own record.

quickPrompts.zh: 先用虚构示例展示健康工作台，再告诉我如何创建自己的档案。
quickPrompts.en: Show me the fictional demo workbench, then explain how to set up my own record.

quickPrompts.zh: 帮我整理这份检验报告，逐个字段列出需要我核对的值。
quickPrompts.en: Organize this lab report and list each field I need to confirm.

quickPrompts.zh: 看看近 30 天的血压变化，并准备下次复诊要带的摘要。
quickPrompts.en: Review my blood pressure over the last 30 days and prepare a summary for my next visit.
